roadmap.title: Opening hours and Breezy Plains basics
roadmap.description: Arrive in Idyll, pick a companion, activate the Branch, and earn your first badge. Add your first friend early.

roadmap.title: Breezy Plains story and first catches
roadmap.description: Clear Blooms, Journey quests, the lore, the first Sanctum, your first Alpha, and your first Index entries. Photos and hugs are quick.

roadmap.title: Ranks, badges, and the Homeland
roadmap.description: Raise your rank, earn badges, hatch eggs, build the Homeland, and unlock Egg Heist at Character Level 50.

roadmap.title: Long collection grinds
roadmap.description: Chests, Sanctums, Index records, levels, Alphas, Pathfinder Challenges, RV levels, and rank climbing run alongside normal play.

roadmap.title: Late-game hunts and friend tasks
roadmap.description: Chase rare Prismana variants, top Egg Heist ranks, Interlink stars, Victory Badges, and the tasks that need a friend.

achievements.displayName: First Step into a New World
achievements.description: Step onto the lands of Idyll.
achievements.summary: Step onto the lands of Idyll.

steps.text: Start the game and arrive in @loc{Idyll}; this unlocks on its own.

achievements.description: Team up with Helion or Lunara.
achievements.summary: Team up with Helion or Lunara as your first companion.

steps.text: Follow the opening story and choose either @npc{Helion} or @npc{Lunara} to team up with.

achievements.description: Earn limited badge: Starbound Journey.
achievements.summary: Earn the limited badge named Starbound Journey.

guide.context: This badge is described as limited, so watch for it early in the game.

steps.text: Play through the opening and earn the Starbound Journey badge.

achievements.description: Activate the Branch in Breezy Plains and receive the ancient blessing.
achievements.summary: Switch on the Branch in Breezy Plains and take the ancient blessing it offers.

steps.text: Go to the Branch in @loc{Breezy Plains} during the early story and activate it.

achievements.description: Earn your first Collection Badge.
achievements.summary: Earn your first Collection Badge.

guide.context: Each region has four badge levels: Bronze, Silver, Gold, and Prismatic. Open the map, select a fast travel point, then the Badge icon to see a badge's conditions.

steps.text: Open the Badge icon on the map and meet the conditions for a Bronze badge.

achievements.description: Illuminate 10 Blooms and converge the beams.
achievements.summary: Light 10 Blooms and make their beams meet.

steps.text: Touch Blooms as you explore @loc{Breezy Plains}; each one lights up and unlocks fast travel.
After 10 are lit, check the area for the beams meeting.

achievements.description: Cross every area of Breezy Plains.
achievements.summary: Cross every area of Breezy Plains.

steps.text: Explore each area of @loc{Breezy Plains} until the map shows all of them as visited.

achievements.description: Level up the Branch in Breezy Plains to Prismana Radiance.
achievements.summary: Raise the Breezy Plains Branch to the Prismana Radiance level.

guide.context: Feeding Lumin Amber to a Branch raises it. At 10, 20, and later totals it adds perks, up to 150 Lumin Amber.

steps.text: Pick up every Lumin Amber you pass.
Feed it to the Branch in @loc{Breezy Plains} until it reaches Prismana Radiance.

achievements.description: Level up the Branch in Breezy Plains to Wanderer’s Might.
achievements.summary: Raise the Breezy Plains Branch to the Wanderer's Might level.

guide.context: The Branch is raised by feeding Lumin Amber; the last perk is at 150 Lumin Amber.

steps.text: Keep feeding Lumin Amber to the Branch in @loc{Breezy Plains} until it reaches Wanderer's Might.

achievements.description: Witness a Prismana Flow.
achievements.summary: Witness a Prismana Flow.

guide.context: Prismana Flow is a weather type shown on the map forecast. It also starts if you offer Prismana Crystals at the Breezy Plains Branch.

steps.text: Check the weather map for a Prismana Flow, or offer Prismana Crystals at the Branch in @loc{Breezy Plains}.
Be in the area while it is active.

achievements.description: Complete the Journey quests: Binding Oath, Stars and the Knight, and Warrior.
achievements.summary: Finish these three Journey quests: Warrior, Binding Oath, and Stars and the Knight.

guide.context: Journey quests are listed under the Journey tab of the Log. Most start from a map clue marked with a lightbulb.

steps.text: Beat the boss Tucking in @loc{The Mistwoods}, then follow the new clue to start Binding Oath.
Take the clue The Aging Sherro and defeat the Aged Omega Sherro to start Stars and the Knight.
Finish the Warrior quest in @loc{Russet Highlands}.

achievements.description: Finish the Breezy Plains lore.
achievements.summary: Finish the Breezy Plains lore.

steps.text: Open the Lore tab of the Log and fill in every @loc{Breezy Plains} entry.

achievements.description: Reach the destination of every journey in Breezy Plains.
achievements.summary: Reach the end point of every journey in Breezy Plains.

steps.text: Finish each journey in @loc{Breezy Plains} until you have reached its final location.

achievements.description: Each of the 200 Chests across the world contains a surprise.
achievements.summary: Open all 200 Chests in the world.

guide.context: More exploration in an area makes its chests easier to find.

steps.text: Explore every region and open each Chest you find.
Track your count and keep going until all 200 are open.

achievements.description: Clear the first Sanctum and restore the Vein energy.
achievements.summary: Clear the first Sanctum by repairing its Vein.

guide.context: At the start of a Sanctum, wake its special Aniimo and twine with it. That lets you reach the deeper areas.

steps.text: Enter a Sanctum and awaken its special Aniimo.
Solve the puzzles and go to the end.
Repair the Vein to clear it.

achievements.description: 10 Sanctums, each full of challenges.
achievements.summary: Clear 10 Sanctums.

guide.context: Use the Sanctum pins on the map to find them.

steps.text: Visit Sanctum pins on the map.
Clear each one by reaching the end and repairing its Vein, until you have 10.

achievements.description: Become a Novice Trailblazer.
achievements.summary: Reach the Novice Trailblazer rank.

steps.text: Raise your Character Level and finish the rank quests until the rank shows as Novice Trailblazer.

achievements.description: Become a Junior Wayfarer.
achievements.summary: Reach the Junior Wayfarer rank.

steps.text: Keep raising your Character Level and promotion quests until the rank shows as Junior Wayfarer.

achievements.description: Reach Level 60.
achievements.summary: Reach Character Level 60.

guide.context: Story progress gives about 1,000-1,200 EXP at a time. The first catch of each new Aniimo gives 300 EXP. Daily Quests give up to 3,000 EXP a day.

steps.text: Do the main story and Daily Quests.
Catch every Aniimo marked New.
Keep going until your Character Level is 60.

achievements.description: Collect 20 badges.
achievements.summary: Collect 20 badges.

guide.context: Each region has four badge levels, and every badge counts.

steps.text: Meet the conditions for Bronze, Silver, and Gold badges across regions until you have 20.

achievements.description: 10 Aniimo recorded in the Index, more friends to connect with.
achievements.summary: Record 10 Aniimo in the Index.

steps.text: Catch Aniimo marked New; each catch records an Index entry.

achievements.description: 40 Aniimo recorded in the Index, more companions to find.
achievements.summary: Record 40 Aniimo in the Index.

steps.text: Keep catching new Aniimo until the Index shows 40.

achievements.description: 80 Aniimo recorded in the Index, every page full of memories.
achievements.summary: Record 80 Aniimo in the Index.

guide.context: Some Aniimo appear only at certain times of day or in certain weather, so come back at a different time if an area has nothing new.

steps.text: Visit every region.
Return at other times of day and in other weather to find new Aniimo.
Keep recording until the Index shows 80.

achievements.description: Witness 10 Eggs hatching.
achievements.summary: Watch 10 Eggs hatch.

guide.context: A Hatchinator holds up to 3 eggs at once, and petting it speeds up hatching.

steps.text: Place eggs in a Hatchinator at your camp or in your RV.
Wait for the timer to finish and watch each egg hatch, until you have seen 10.

achievements.displayName: You’re Gonna Need a Bigger Aniipod
achievements.description: Obtain your first Alpha Aniimo.
achievements.summary: Obtain your first Alpha Aniimo.

guide.context: A better Aniipod helps a lot. Breaking an Alpha first raises your catch rate, and throwing from behind gives a 1.5x boost.

steps.text: Break an Alpha, or wait until it sleeps or is at low HP.
Throw an Aniipod from behind it to catch it.

achievements.description: Your first Sparkling Aniimo, faintly shimmering.
achievements.summary: Obtain your first Sparkling Aniimo.

guide.context: A Sparkling Cube gives you the best chance to catch a Sparkling Aniimo, so keep it for one you really want.

steps.text: Look for a shimmering Sparkling Aniimo while exploring.
Use a Sparkling Cube to improve your chance of catching it.

achievements.description: Your first Prismana Aniimo, brilliantly hued.
achievements.summary: Obtain your first Prismana Aniimo.

guide.context: At Character Level 40 and after its story quest, you become Wayfarer I and can pick a free Prismana Aniimo in the Prismana Pact event. Prismana Flow weather also raises wild Prismana chances.

steps.text: Reach Wayfarer I and pick your Prismana Aniimo in the Prismana Pact event.
Or hatch an egg or catch one during a Prismana Flow.

achievements.description: 5 Perfect Aniimo. The path ahead is bright.
achievements.summary: Obtain 5 Perfect Aniimo.

guide.context: Umbral Aniimo Eggs, a reward in Operation: Egg Heist, hatch an Umbral Aniimo that has Perfect potential.

steps.text: Catch or hatch Aniimo and keep the ones with Perfect potential.
Keep going until 5 show as Perfect.

achievements.description: A Sparkling Prismana Aniimo, dazzlingly radiant.
achievements.summary: Obtain an Aniimo that is both Sparkling and Prismana.

steps.text: Find or hatch a Prismana Aniimo.
Hatch Prismana eggs, or catch Prismana Aniimo in the wild, until one is also Sparkling.

achievements.description: 10 Prismana Aniimo. That’s a whole squad of rare ones.
achievements.summary: Collect 10 Prismana Aniimo.

guide.context: Mysterious Prismana Eggs from Operation: Egg Heist on Hard or higher always hatch a Prismana Aniimo.

steps.text: Catch Prismana Aniimo during Prismana Flow weather.
Hatch Mysterious Prismana Eggs from Egg Heist rewards until you own 10.

achievements.description: Obtain a Level 10 Carried Item.
achievements.summary: Obtain a Carried Item at Level 10.

steps.text: Get a Carried Item and raise its level to 10.

achievements.description: Ascend an Aniimo to 6 stars for the first time. What an achievement!
achievements.summary: Raise one Aniimo to 6 stars through Ascension.

guide.context: Resonance unlocks at Character Level 2. Star-Up uses Dewdrop Crystals; Ascension needs the right level and elemental stones.

steps.text: Pick one Aniimo and open its Resonance screen.
Spend Dewdrop Crystals to fill its stars and Ascend it when each stage is full.
Continue until it shows 6 stars.

achievements.description: Earn the Bronze Collection Badge for Breezy Plains.
achievements.summary: Get the Bronze Collection Badge of the Breezy Plains region.

steps.text: Open the Badge icon at a fast travel point in @loc{Breezy Plains}.
Meet the Bronze conditions, such as catching the local Aniimo.

achievements.description: Earn the Silver Collection Badge for Breezy Plains.
achievements.summary: Get the Silver Collection Badge of the Breezy Plains region.

steps.text: Open the Badge icon at a fast travel point in @loc{Breezy Plains}.
Meet the Silver conditions.

achievements.description: Earn the Gold Collection Badge for Breezy Plains.
achievements.summary: Get the Gold Collection Badge of the Breezy Plains region.

steps.text: Open the Badge icon at a fast travel point in @loc{Breezy Plains}.
Meet the Gold conditions.

achievements.description: Upgrade the Breezy Plains Aniilog to Level 9.
achievements.summary: Raise the Aniilog of Breezy Plains to Level 9.

steps.text: Open the Aniilog for @loc{Breezy Plains}.
Upgrade it repeatedly until it shows Level 9.

achievements.description: Team up with Irisalis.
achievements.summary: Team up with Irisalis.

guide.context: This is the end of the Rainbow of the Ground story section. It uses the same four Chapter 5 quests as the III Wayfarer promotion at Character Level 50.

steps.text: Follow the Rainbow of the Ground main quests.
Finish the Chapter 5 quests to team up with @npc{Irisalis}.

achievements.description: Defeat 5 Alpha/Omega Aniimo.
achievements.summary: Defeat 5 Alpha or Omega Aniimo.

guide.context: Each Alpha attempt costs Primegy, so fight them only once you are prepared.

steps.text: Find Alpha or Omega Aniimo in the world and defeat them, until you have 5.

achievements.description: Defeat 20 Alpha/Omega Aniimo.
achievements.summary: Defeat 20 Alpha or Omega Aniimo.

guide.context: Each Alpha fight costs Primegy.

steps.text: Keep defeating Alpha and Omega Aniimo until you have 20.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Pathfinder Challenges, steady and sure.
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Pathfinder Challenges.

steps.text: Find Pathfinders around the world, for example Pathfinder Theo in @loc{Breezy Plains}.
Win their challenges until you have 10.

achievements.description: Complete 50 Pathfinder Challenges, forged through perseverance.
achievements.summary: Complete 50 Pathfinder Challenges.

steps.text: Keep meeting and beating Pathfinders as you explore until you have 50 wins.

achievements.description: Clear any one of the Grass, Water or Fire Holo-Battle Sim.
achievements.summary: Clear one Holo-Battle Sim in Grass, Water, or Fire.

steps.text: Open the Holo-Battle Sim and pick Grass, Water, or Fire.
Finish the run.

achievements.description: Clear any one of the Grass, Water or Fire Holo-Battle Sim on the highest difficulty.
achievements.summary: Beat a Holo-Battle Sim of the Grass, Water, or Fire type with the difficulty set to the top level.

steps.text: Open the Holo-Battle Sim and pick Grass, Water, or Fire.
Set the highest difficulty and finish the run.

achievements.description: Successfully evacuate in Operation: Egg Heist
achievements.summary: Evacuate successfully in Operation: Egg Heist.

guide.context: Egg Heist is reported to open at Character Level 50 once you finish Dr. Lewis's Assessment. Your first 3 runs on every difficulty are protected, so a failed run does not cost you your items.

steps.text: Enter the Lost Sanctum on Normal difficulty.
Submit 1 Egg and gather 20,000 Eggshell Coins of loot within 20 minutes.
Reach the Egg Boat and evacuate.

achievements.description: Evacuate safely in Operation: Egg Heist Team Mode on Nightmare.
achievements.summary: Finish an Operation: Egg Heist Team Mode run on Nightmare by safely leaving on the Egg Boat.

guide.context: Nightmare needs a Gilded Key for locked rooms and Epic gear. Fainting after Beginner Protection costs everything except items in the Egg Boat Safe.

steps.text: Enter the Lost Sanctum in Team Mode on Nightmare.
Submit 1 Egg and gather 150,000 Eggshell Coins of loot within 15 minutes.
Reach the Egg Boat and evacuate.

achievements.description: Reach the Rising Egg Scout rank in Operation: Egg Heist.
achievements.summary: Rank up to Rising Egg Scout in Operation: Egg Heist.

guide.context: Your first successful run each day gives double Rank Points.

steps.text: Run Operation: Egg Heist and extract successfully.
Repeat until your rank changes from Rookie Egg Hunter to Rising Egg Scout.

achievements.description: Reach the Expert Egg Raider rank in Operation: Egg Heist.
achievements.summary: Rank up to Expert Egg Raider in Operation: Egg Heist.

guide.context: The ranks go Rookie Egg Hunter, Rising Egg Scout, Pro Egg Snatcher, Elite Egg Seeker, then Expert Egg Raider. Your first successful run each day gives double Rank Points.

steps.text: Extract successfully at least once a day.
Raise your rank through each step until you are Expert Egg Raider.

achievements.description: Obtain 5 Prismatic collectibles in Operation: Egg Heist.
achievements.summary: Pick up 5 Prismatic collectibles during Operation: Egg Heist runs.

guide.context: Store valuable collectibles in the Egg Boat Safe so you do not lose them if you faint. They may need to be 5 different items.

steps.text: Search the Lost Sanctum for Prismatic collectibles.
Put them in the Egg Boat Safe and extract, until you have 5.

achievements.description: Get 50 stars in the Holo-Battle Interlink.
achievements.summary: Gather 50 stars altogether while playing the Holo-Battle Interlink.

steps.text: Play the Holo-Battle Interlink and collect stars from each stage until the total reaches 50.

achievements.description: Snatch 6 Victory Badges from Elite Pathfinders.
achievements.summary: Win 6 Victory Badges from Elite Pathfinders.

steps.text: Find the Elite Pathfinders and beat them.
Take a Victory Badge from each until you have 6.

achievements.description: Capture a moment with your Aniimo by your side.
achievements.summary: Take a photo with your Aniimo next to you.

steps.text: Call out your Aniimo, open the camera, and take a photo with it beside you.

achievements.description: Hug your Aniimo for the first time.
achievements.summary: Give your Aniimo its first hug.

steps.text: Stand next to your Aniimo and use its hug action.

achievements.description: The Homeland is complete, and now you have a place to call your own.
achievements.summary: Complete the Homeland.

guide.context: The RV comes from the quest Prologue: The Wondrous RV, after you pass Dr. Lewis's test and become a Grade II Student. Its button next to the quest tracker starts greyed out, so check the quest Log if you miss it.

steps.text: Finish the promotion quest Promotion: Dewdrop Crystal's Resonance.
Start Prologue: The Wondrous RV and meet Fannie.
Do the Home quests until the Homeland is complete.

achievements.description: Your Aniimo go on 5 trips and came back loaded with gifts.
achievements.summary: Dispatch your Aniimo on 5 separate trips and pick up what they bring home.

guide.context: Trips unlock at RV Level 6 with the Signal Transmitter. The lengths are On Foot (6 h), Adventure (12 h), and Camping (20 h).

steps.text: Reach RV Level 6 and buy the Signal Transmitter.
Station Aniimo at an RV Park and send them on a trip.
Collect the gifts when they return, until you have done 5.

achievements.description: Fulfill 80 Home orders.
achievements.summary: Fulfill 80 Home orders.

guide.context: The list holds 9 orders at most, and you get 5 free refreshes each day.

steps.text: Open the Daily Orders list.
Deliver the requested items until you have filled 80.

achievements.description: Upgrade RV to Level 8. It’s becoming more and more like a proper home.
achievements.summary: Upgrade the RV to Level 8.

guide.context: RV upgrades cost Home Coins and Homeland byproducts.

steps.text: Earn Home Coins from orders and sales.
Upgrade the RV each time you can afford it, until it shows Level 8.

achievements.description: 500k Credits slip through your fingers.
achievements.summary: Have 500,000 Credits pass through your hands.

guide.context: Spend Credits rather than only earning them, so the total counts.

steps.text: Earn and spend Credits normally until the total reaches 500,000.

achievements.description: Play the flute and meet with the first Pathfinder.
achievements.summary: Use the flute to call and meet your first Pathfinder.

steps.text: Use the flute and meet the Pathfinder who answers.

achievements.description: Reach Level 5 Bond with a friend.
achievements.summary: Reach Bond Level 5 with a friend.

steps.text: Add a friend.
Keep playing with your friend until your Bond Level reaches 5.

achievements.description: Gift 1 Aniimo to a friend in Companion Mode.
achievements.summary: Give one of your Aniimo to a friend while in Companion Mode.

steps.text: Join a friend in Companion Mode.
Choose an Aniimo and give it to them.

achievements.description: Complete 1 Aniimo exchange. Both sides get what they wanted.
achievements.summary: Complete 1 Aniimo exchange with a friend.

steps.text: Start a trade with a friend.
Both of you pick an Aniimo and confirm the swap.

achievements.description: Take 1 photo with a friend in the Photo Studio.
achievements.summary: Shoot one photo together with a friend inside the Photo Studio.

guide.context: This achievement may not unlock on PC after the photo is taken.

steps.text: Invite a friend to the Photo Studio.
Take a photo together.

achievements.description: Fill your wardrobe with 5 outfits. A fresh new look every day.
achievements.summary: Own 5 outfits in your wardrobe.

steps.text: Collect outfits until the wardrobe holds 5.

achievements.description: Add your first friend.
achievements.summary: Add your first friend.

steps.text: Open the friends menu and add another player.
